### God Speaks to Jacob
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-speaks-jacob
Passage: Genesis 31:3
Points:
- Jacob's labor under Laban humbled him, transforming him from a deceiver into a more disciplined man.
- God prospered Jacob despite Laban's unfair treatment, inciting jealousy and hostility from Laban's household.
- Rather than fleeing solely out of fear, Jacob waited until the Lord explicitly commanded him to return home.
- God reaffirmed His covenant promises to Jacob, assuring him of His abiding presence and steadfast love.
- Believers should not rely on circumstances alone when making major decisions, but must seek clear direction from God's Word.
